assessment: This study demonstrates that elevated secretome fucosylation is a pan cancer signature of both response and resistance to multiple FDA approved targeted therapies using both disease relevant cell lines and in vivo model systems. The authors go on to identify the antioxidant protein PON1 as a critical regulator of therpy induced changes in the secretome. Lastly, the authors define the resistance associated transcription factors and gene modulated by changes in the secretome. Collectively, these studies have the potential to define the mechanisms of drug resistance and identify novel targetable pathways for cancer treatment.
